ck.title: Payments
ck.sub: How customers pay online, and which of your accounts the money lands in.
ck.note: Grab the handle on the left of a row and drag it to move it (on a phone, press and drag). Or use the arrow buttons. Nothing here moves money or changes a price.
ck.readOnly: You can look but not change. Changing these needs the settings editing permission.
ck.saved: Saved. The checkout shows it now.
ck.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
ck.dragHelp: Press and drag, or use the arrow keys

err.STALE: Someone else changed this just now. It has been read again, so please make your change again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something here is not right. Check the numbers and words and try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: Only an owner can change Cash on Delivery.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this.
err.other: It was not saved. Please try again.

form.d: The three boxes your customer fills in (name, phone, address), how short they may be, and the small lines around them.
form.range: A number is outside the allowed range. Check the numbers and try again.
form.orderHelp: The customer is asked in this order, and the first unfinished box is the one the form points at. All three boxes are always asked.
form.always: Always asked (the name is skipped when its shortest length is 0)
form.nameMinHelp: From {min} to {max}. 0 means the checkout does not ask for a name: the order then carries the phone number in its place. Phone and address are always asked (the courier, the delivery charge and the messages need them).
form.addressMinHelp: From {min} to {max}. A longer minimum makes riders' lives easier.
form.manyMin: Pieces of one size before the reminder
form.confirm: While the form is not finished
form.confirmAsk: The button asks for the missing box
form.confirmHelp: Asking: pressing the button takes the customer to the box that is missing and asks him there. Switched off: the button waits until the form is finished.

payments.d: Which ways to pay the checkout offers, in what order, and the numbers and accounts your customers send money to.
payments.needOne: A payment way that is switched on needs at least one choice shown.
payments.fillRows: Fill in every number and every bank account, or remove the empty row.
payments.codHelp: Your own decision. Nothing is offered until you choose, and only an owner can change it.
payments.codOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change Cash on Delivery.
payments.walletsHelp: Your bKash, Nagad, Rocket or Upay numbers. A Bangladesh mobile number can be typed as 01XXXXXXXXX.
payments.banksHelp: The accounts customers can transfer to. Up to 10.
payments.show: Receiving numbers on the thank-you page
payments.showHelp: For an order that waits for a prepaid payment, the customer sees the numbers and bank accounts above, to send the money to. Off: nothing of the kind is shown.
payments.showOn: Show the receiving numbers to a customer who still has to pay

gift.d: The "Send as a gift" link in the bag: the gift note, the delivery day, and whether the receiver's invoice hides prices. Its advance is money, so only an owner changes this card.
gift.ownerOnly: Only an owner changes the gift card.
gift.range: A number is outside the allowed range. Check the numbers and try again.
gift.noteMaxHelp: From 0 to 1000. 0 hides the note box.
gift.maxDaysHelp: From 0 to 365. 0 hides the delivery-day box.
gift.hidePrices: Hide prices on the receiver's invoice, to start with
gift.advanceHelp: Money the customer pays ahead. Until part payment comes, the team gets a call task to collect a part.

settle.d: Which of your accounts each way of paying settles into, and in how many working days. A note the books read; it moves no money.
settle.note: Changing where money lands is for the owner. Finance › Money in & out matches every payment against these accounts.
settle.saved: Saved. New payments are noted against these accounts.
settle.failed: That did not save. Try again.
settle.FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can change where money lands.
settle.ACCOUNT_NOT_LISTED: Every way of paying must use an account from your list.
settle.INVALID_INPUT: Some values are not right (days are 0 to 30).
settle.readOnly: Only the owner can change this.
